user.title: Add a coffee machine
user.description: Choose your coffee machine’s power sensor in W or kW. Espresso shots are counted at the end of a phase. Live status and milk/steam phases are estimates based on power. You can configure the thresholds after adding the machine. Rocket Appartamento is the original profile from this installation; Custom is a copied starting point, not a universally validated machine preset.

reconfigure.title: Change machine and power sensor
reconfigure.description: Counters, profiles and journal are retained.

init.title: Choose detection profile
init.description: Source: {power_entity}. Rocket Appartamento preserves the original settings. New profiles copy the selected profile; changes to Rocket are saved as a separate copy. Use the device entities for calibration.Select an action for diagnostics/settings or profile import/export.

milk.title: Configure milk and steam phases
milk.description: Counts estimated milk/steam phases after a detected espresso. Ordinary heating can look similar. The number of phases does not reliably represent the number of milk servings.

features.title: Measurement quality, milk and energy
features.description: Standalone milk is estimated from milk-pump evidence, never heater power alone. Long measurement gaps discard partial operations. Blank energy source uses the known sensor only for the legacy machine; select one for other machines. Energy can be disabled. These features are per machine, not per threshold profile.Cappuccino recipe: Each group starts with one espresso. Exactly the configured number of milk phases yields the configured cups (default: 1 espresso + 2 milk phases → 2 cappuccinos). Assignments remain provisional during the grouping window. Daily counts include completed groups only. Changes reinterpret the retained journal; no volume measurement or assured drink identification. Choose exact or minimum milk-phase matching. Minimum mode assigns the fixed cups even with additional milk phases. Daily counts survive journal expiry.

data.max_gap_s: Maximum report gap during an operation
data.cappuccino_milk_phases: Milk phases per espresso required by recipe
data.cappuccino_match_mode: Milk phases: exactly or at least

import_profile.title: Import profile
import_profile.description: Paste JSON and choose a new name. Saves a copy without activating or replacing the original.

export_profile.title: Export profile
